evidence_items.content: Repaired INV-000032 final coding gives candidate A『名前が旧橋へ戻る』 D21=A4 and candidate B『物流だけが橋を移る』 D21=A4. A has D07=U for the name/place identity taxonomy gap, D09=HISTORICAL_ANCHOR(+NAMING), D10=SYMBOL_NAME_IMAGE(+SPECIFIC_PLACE), D13=MENTAL_INFLUENCE, D15=PERCEPTUAL_DISTURBANCE, and D16=C. B has D07=SPATIAL_ROUTE_ANOMALY, D09=CORRELATION_RULE, D10=ROUTE_CONNECTION, D13=REALITY_ALTERATION, D15=REALITY_TRUST_LOSS, and D16=C.

evidence_items.content: Repaired INV-000032 final coding gives candidate C『三つの二川』 D21=A4 and candidate D『二つの村が一つの宿になる』 D21=A4. C has D07=U for settlement identity across historical places, D09=HISTORICAL_ANCHOR(+BOUNDARY_CLASSIFICATION), D10=SPATIOTEMPORAL_FIELD(+SPECIFIC_PLACE), D13=SPATIAL_DISTORTION(+REALITY_REPLACEMENT), D16=SEQUENTIAL_EPISODE. evidence_items.content: Repaired INV-000032 final coding gives candidate E『二十三キロの近道』 D21=A2 and candidate F『土地ではなく水路が住所を決める』 D21=A3. Both map D10 to ROUTE_CONNECTION, but E has D07=SPATIAL_ROUTE_ANOMALY, D09=CORRELATION_RULE, D13=MENTAL_INFLUENCE, D15=PERCEPTUAL_DISTURBANCE, D16=SEQUENTIAL_EPISODE; F has D07=U for land-identity taxonomy gap, D09=BOUNDARY_CLASSIFICATION(+NAMING,+DIRECT_CAUSE), D10 additionally SPECIFIC_PLACE, D13=REALITY_ALTERATION, D15=REALITY_TRUST_LOSS, D16=CONTINUOUS.

evidence_items.content: Repaired INV-000032 finalizes all candidate-side D01–D21 states. Across A–F, D01=D01.G8; D02–D06 and D19 are NA for the pre-circulation creative-model Version Scope; D08,D12,D14,D20 are U; D18=L1 for all. D21 is A/B/C/D=A4, E=A2, F=A3. Candidate A/B keep D16=C because their source definitions contain competing temporal alternatives rather than a single forced value.
evidence_items.selection_reason: INV-000033 frozen contextが要求する『RQ-000032で確定したD01–D21 coding』を直接pinするため

evidence_items.content: Repaired INV-000032 interprets the formal D21 assignments conservatively: A–D are A4 because concrete historical changes are integrated into the causal rule; E is A2 because it uses a specific real irrigation network as the concrete anchor without making its history itself the causal rule; F is A3 because the real reclaimed-land/infrastructure relation is necessary to the model's existence. The same analysis explicitly rejects treating D21 or corpus rarity as quality or as a general causal effect on other dimensions.
evidence_items.selection_reason: D21差の意味と境界をupstream formal coding resultから保持するため

evidence_items.content: 江戸時代の「吉田大橋」は現在の「とよばし」の位置にあり、現在の「吉田大橋」はそのやや上流に新たに架けられた。国道1号の通過に伴い物流の中心も旧吉田大橋から現在の吉田大橋へ移った。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 候補A/Bで因果化される名称・位置・物流中心の史実を元Sourceへtrace可能に保つため

evidence_items.content: 二川宿成立以前、二川村・大岩村は本郷から元屋敷へ移転した記録があり、正保元年（1644）には両村が現在地へ移転して一続きの宿場町となった。
evidence_items.source_locator: 「二川村・大岩村の移転と二川宿の成立」
evidence_items.selection_reason: 候補C/Dで因果化される段階的移転と集落統合の史実を元Sourceへtrace可能に保つため

evidence_items.content: 1893年に神野金之助が毛利新田を購入し、人造石工法を用いた築堤で新田開発を進めた。牟呂用水は新城市一鍬田から神野新田まで約23kmを引水する。同一資料内で完成年は1899年と1888年の異なる記載があり、このEvidenceだけでは単一の完成年を確定できない。
evidence_items.source_locator: 「神野新田と牟呂用水」／「世界かんがい施設遺産：松原用水・牟呂用水」
evidence_items.selection_reason: 候補E/Fが利用する造成史・水利接続を元Sourceへtraceし、完成年conflictを保持するため

evidence_items.content: Canonical D21 defines A0=anonymous/abstract, A1=general real-world background, A2=specific identifiable real target, A3=real institution/social history necessary to model existence, and A4=concrete historical fact/record/existing lore integrated into causal structure. Coding rules require separating source reality from the lore model's reality dependence and prohibit filling unknown values by guess.
evidence_items.selection_reason: D21 A2/A3/A4差の定義とcoding boundaryを独立に固定するため
